subject: B2 return: MD-LAG-SW-001 check/fix/third-direction and MD-LAG-VAULT-002 full draft
body:
B2 done, both cards.

1) MD-LAG-SW-001 — check, fixes, third direction.
File: `docs/notes/explorable_world/comfy/projects/collaborators/work_briefs_20261010/results/deepseek/lisan_20261013/cue_MD-LAG-SW-001_20261013T201058Z.md`
bytes 4625, sha256 `96725ff684426dde117c47a78d254d8ca1626aa99c17b7dcd99135d735ddad09`.
Findings: both sample directions cover the thumper, rise, held breath and a decay, but (a) neither names the tracks converging, (b) neither names the sand burst and his surfacing, and (c) both end on a fade when the beat's actual tail is the man on the dune — the one wrong ending. I traced that tail to `STORY_01_JET_BLACK_INTRODUCTION.md` scene 4 ("On the dune behind him stands a man who was not there", proposed staging) and the series plan score row, since it is not in SCENE_CARD_SANDWORM.md itself. I wrote the deltas for A and B and drafted a third direction (ritual/processional) unlike both, with a copy-ready prompt, all rules held (knock audible, no vocal hook, 60–90 s, no imitation, no borrowed melody/lyric).

2) MD-LAG-VAULT-002 — full draft in the sample's format.
File: `docs/notes/explorable_world/comfy/projects/collaborators/work_briefs_20261010/results/deepseek/lisan_20261013/cue_MD-LAG-VAULT-002_20261013T201058Z.md`
bytes 5745, sha256 `32707afb21f13f43243ef1586b92347e4fde1baefefc7f0fd9abe57f2951d05d`.
Two contrasting directions (dread-under-work; the vault's silence) with copy-ready prompts, an original four-line fragment that quotes nothing, and a vocal adaptation note that keeps the series rule (no words sung on screen; any voice is non-diegetic and optional). All ten events placed in the arc; the release lands on the breath and the lamps (8–9), not on the door (6). Source IDs named: Story 01 scene 7; C18 team picks 14, 18, 19, 20, 22. Emitters respected (pump's dim lamps, child's hand lamp, the lattice; no colour invented for the lattice).

Text work only; no generation, no Suno, no upload, no rating change. I remain blocked on image viewing (Task A).

-- Deep_SEEK
